blockers.title: Pressing Enter while fixing an unread line saves the whole roster and silently drops that student
blockers.location: src/features/students/StudentScanAssistant.tsx:191-197 (the line Input sits inside the review <form>); src/features/students/StudentScan.tsx:1234-1239, 1453-1462, 875-886
blockers.scenario: Paste 'Veldor;Marta;12/03/2010;16;' and 'Neri;Paolo;31/02/2011;15;'. The operator taps Controlla on row 1, then corrects line 4 to 'Neri;Paolo;28/02/2011;15;' and presses Enter (the phone keyboard's Invio/Vai key). Implicit form submission runs commitCandidates. Every candidate is ready, so createStudents saves only [Veldor Marta], onCommitted leaves the screen, and Neri Paolo is lost with no confirmation. Proven by probe enter.probe.test.tsx: saved ['Veldor Marta'], onCommitted called once.
blockers.suggestedFix: Make Enter in the unread-line input run 'Rileggi riga' and never submit: handle onKeyDown Enter with preventDefault, or move the section out of the <form>. Independently of that, commitCandidates must refuse, or ask for explicit confirmation, while pasteImport.unparsed is not empty (see V5-3).

blockers.title: The stored birth date of a pasted row is never shown in the review, so the required check cannot cover it
blockers.location: src/capabilities/rosterPaste.ts:164-171 (confidence set to 100 for every date); src/features/students/StudentScan.tsx:210-219, 559-574 (the date field only renders when the date 'needs attention'); src/capabilities/studentScanReview.ts:115-131 (±1 tolerance)
blockers.scenario: The sheet reads 12/03/2010 with age 16. The assistant swaps day and month (a classic LLM slip) and answers 'Veldor;Marta;03/12/2010;16;'. The review renders Nome, Cognome, Età=16 and Sesso. The date input count is 0 and the page never mentions 2010. Everything on screen matches the sheet, so the operator taps Controlla and saves. Stored dateOfBirth is 2010-12-03 and the student is 15 from then on. A date-only answer 'Veldor;Marta;03/12/2010;;' behaves the same: age 15 is shown, the date stays hidden and is saved. A one-year misread of the birth year that is corroborated by a copied or LLM-computed age is also invisible. Only a flip across the 18-year boundary is caught. Proven by ui.probe P1/P1b. The parser comment 'values are shown as they were written' is false for the most error-prone field. This gets worse if the owner accepts the open question about a single 'all checked' confirmation.
blockers.suggestedFix: For rowWarning 'from-assistant', always show the read birth date whenever one is present (for example set dateOfBirth confidence below MIN_FIELD_CONFIDENCE, or force showDateField). Keep the date visible after Controlla. Consider requiring exact age/date agreement for pasted rows, or ignoring an assistant age when a date is given. Add corpus and component cases for a day/month swap and a one-year year slip.

importantFindings.title: Unread lines and a missing FINE neither block nor count toward the save; the counters report the review as done
importantFindings.scenario: Paste 3 rows where 2 have invalid dates. The counters show '1 righe da controllare'. After one Controlla tap they show 0 rows to check and 1 ready, and 'Aggiungi 1 allievo' saves. Both unread student lines are discarded without any question, although 'Righe non lette (2)' is still on screen (ui.probe P4). With a 30-row sheet the section sits far above the save button. The 'risposta interrotta' banner does not gate the save either.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Count each remaining unread line in 'righe da controllare' and let the counter jump to it. Require an explicit per-line 'Lascia fuori', or one confirmation listing the unread lines, before saving. Do the same for an answer without FINE.

importantFindings.title: Leave guard is off when a pasted review holds only unread lines, so in-place fixes are lost without a question
importantFindings.scenario: Paste an answer whose rows are numbered ('1. Veldor;Marta;...'). The result is 0 candidates and 2 unread lines. The operator starts correcting 'Testo riga 3' and presses Back. onBack runs immediately and no discard prompt appears (ui.probe P3). 'Scegli un'altra immagine' also skips the question. When candidates exist, the discard prompt counts only candidates ('Scartare la revisione di N allievi?') and ignores unread lines.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Enable the guard when candidates.length > 0 || (pasteImport && pasteImport.unparsed.length > 0), and mention the unread lines in the discard text.

importantFindings.title: Duplicated rows (LLM repetition, a second block re-read, or a line fixed into a copy) are saved as duplicate students with no warning
importantFindings.scenario: The answer repeats 'Veldor;Marta;12/03/2010;16;'. Both rows pass the per-row check, because each one does match the sheet. Two identical students are saved (P5). Fixing an unread 4-field copy of an existing row and re-reading it also adds a second Veldor Marta (P6). Nothing compares the batch with itself or with students already in the course, so pasting the same answer twice doubles the roster.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: Flag rows whose normalized surname, name and date or age repeat inside the batch, or match an existing course student, with a row warning that needs its own resolution (for example rowWarning 'possible-duplicate').

importantFindings.title: The prompt does not pin down the trailing empty fields, and a systematic deviation leaves only line-by-line repair
importantFindings.location: src/capabilities/rosterPaste.ts:27-45, 107-115; src/features/students/StudentScanAssistant.tsx:67-75 (the answer textarea unmounts after import)
importantFindings.scenario: Many assistants drop trailing empty fields and write 'Veldor;Marta;12/03/2010;16' with no phone. The strict parser correctly rejects the line ('4 campi invece di 5'), but then every row on a phone-less sheet is unread and must be retyped on a phone. Tabs, quoted CSV fields and ',' separators fail the same way, and normalizeLine turns tabs into spaces, so tab rows cannot be re-split. The pasted answer is gone after import, so re-asking the assistant means discarding the review. This is the 'autogol' the owner warned about. No evidence tests any real assistant's output; the corpus is hand-written.
importantFindings.suggestedFix: State in the prompt that every row has exactly 4 ';' even when the last fields are empty (for example 'una riga senza telefono termina con ;'), and that Età is copied only if printed, never calculated. When most lines fail for the same reason, show one hint to copy the instructions again and re-paste, with a way back to the paste field. Record a few real-assistant answers (fictitious sheet) in the corpus or evidence.

qolFindings.title: The phone column is validated and requested even when 'Leggi anche il telefono' is off
qolFindings.scenario: With phone off, 'Veldor;Marta;;16;333-1234567' becomes unread ('telefono non valido') for a value the operator never wanted. The prompt still asks the assistant to transcribe minors' phone numbers.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Skip phone validation when readPhone is false, and optionally tell the assistant to leave Telefono empty when the phone is off.

qolFindings.title: Header words or a semicolon comment become a candidate student
qolFindings.scenario: 'Cognome;Nome;;;' becomes a student named 'Nome Cognome' (P8). 'Nota; riga illeggibile;;;' becomes 'riga illeggibile Nota' with sex guessed 'Donna' (P9). Both are held only by the missing age and the row check.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Report a row as unread when a name equals a header word or a known placeholder (Cognome, Nome, Nota, ILLEGGIBILE, ?).

qolFindings.title: The mandatory Controlla tap also clears the implausible-age flag
qolFindings.scenario: 'Veldor;Marta;;0;' shows age 0 flagged. The single Controlla tap, which every pasted row needs anyway, makes it ready, and declaredAgeAtCourseStart 0 is saved (P7). The same happens to a 1910 year slip that gives age 116.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: For pasted rows, clear an out-of-range age only by editing or acknowledging the age itself, not by the row check.

qolFindings.title: A truncated answer can yield a valid-looking truncated last phone
qolFindings.scenario: With the phone on and no FINE, the last line 'Neri;Paolo;01/02/2011;15;3471234' is accepted with no flag on that row and saved as 3471234 after the check (P11). Only the general 'interrotta' banner is shown.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: When complete is false, move the last data line to the unread lines ('forse troncata') or flag that row.

qolFindings.title: Misleading empty-review text and lost sheet order
qolFindings.scenario: An empty block, or an answer with only unread lines, shows 'Hai rimosso tutte le righe' although nothing was removed (P3, P10). Lines fixed in place are appended at the end, which breaks the sheet order the prompt asked for and that the operator uses to compare.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Use a paste-specific empty message, and insert resolved rows at their line position.

qolFindings.title: Minor parser leniencies
qolFindings.scenario: A line such as '```Neri' is treated as a fence and silently skipped. Interior multiple spaces ('De  Varni') are stored as typed. The answer size has no cap: 400 rows plus 400 unread lines took about 8.5 s to render in jsdom.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: Match fences strictly (```[a-z]*), collapse interior whitespace in names, and cap or paginate very large answers.

evidenceInspected: src/features/students/StudentScan.tsx (full review, commit, leave guard, git diff vs HEAD)
grep of V05 files for fetch/XHR/sendBeacon/WebSocket/window.open/URLs: none found, so no-network criterion holds

Probes (scratchpad review-probes/v05, fictitious names): parser.probe (25 malformed variants + 5000-line and 2 MB-line inputs, no crash), ui.probe P1-P11 rendering the real StudentScan, enter.probe, large.probe (400+400 render, no React errors)

Criteria that hold: camera path first (unit test and e2e bounding box), one-tap copy with a selectable fallback, no pasted row reaches ready without Controlla (every path keeps rowWarning; confirmed only via the button), a date/age conflict survives Controlla (P2), formatMissing keeps the pasted text with an error, no network calls
